notes.title: NightDirge 1.1.1 - ReVamp
notes.content:
Here are the updates for NightDirge version 1.1.1!

* Created and added new sprites for important items such as Dirge's swords, Fang's staves and Anna's brooms. You can now further upgrade these weapons once more using a Superior Old Crystal.

* Fang's staff can now be imbued from the newly added hyper boss.
* Added Dirge to the title screen.
* Added the Dirge Rifle.
* Redesigned every level and added new scenery, objects, colors and items.
* Added cards of the Mystic, Warrior, Thief, Paladin, King and Queen and more.
* Added a shrine in Vilks Mountain that provides items depending on your score.
* Added a new kind of aura.
* Added the Chyfrinx Park.
* Added new spells.

* Added a score bonus and area bonus at the end of the game if you reach 75,000 score and cleared all of the bonus areas respectively. The score bonus is 20,000 score and the area bonus is 25,000 score.

* Fixed certain boss drops not appearing in the inventory.
* Fixed tile and sprite issues / sizes.

Introducing in-game achievements and hard mode.

* Achievements will provide the player with an exclusive in-game item if all of them are completed, for each achievement that is completed you will earn experience and other rewards. You will be told of any earned achievements at a red Dirge Glyph.

* The changes in Hard Mode are simple, Dirge has less stats, foes have more moves, items heal less for all characters, Dirge will no longer naturally heal outside of duels and more. You can only activate Hard Mode after you have already completed the game once.

As always, there are more things to see than what is listed!

notes.title: NightDirge 1.1.0 - Merry Christmas
notes.content:
Here's the updates for version 1.1.0.

* Added Christmas decorations and obtainable presents for a limited time. The 2024 presents drop from bosses and will become discontinued after the event is over. There's no auto saving when opening them, try not to be naughty! Or be so... I added a 1/8,000+ chance to receive a special gift.

* Added additional dialogue for Dirge.
* Added the Festive Chocolate Log, Hot Chocolate and Pendant of Christmas.
* Added the Fanged Horns.
* Altered random occurrences so they happen less frequently.
* Altered the stats of certain equipment.

notes.title: NightDirge 1.0.8 - Patriotic Update
notes.content:
* Added the Freedom Cape and Freedom Shield.

* Added the Patriotic Brew.

* Added a new status effect.

* Added more items in the Crimson Woods.

* Adjusted the stats of the playable characters.

* Adjusted the HP of specific foes.

* The Halloween event has been extended.

notes.title: NightDirge 1.0.7
notes.content:
Thank you all for your interest in NightDirge!

* Added more items in Bloodrite City.

* Increased the rare item drop chance from the Vine Magus.

* Increased the SP recovered from Spirit Flowers.

* Decreased the damage done by vine wrap.

* Decreased the drop chance of the paw grenade from various foes.

* Fixed an issue relating to super bosses.

* Fixed the first bonus area not adding Fang to your party after it is over.

* Added the "Tail Magazine" for that one anon.

There will be many more updates to come that will add more content to the game such as new super bosses, auras, gear and more. Oh yeah, be careful in the Bloodrite Hotel around Halloween, I heard it gets pretty crazy in there around that time.
